source.quote: 人体外推前必须至少有 3 个符合该参数要求的物种。完成可支持的指标；符合条件的参数可以交给外推分支审核，原有缺口继续保留 并不一定要房室模型 允许经审核的人源体外结合／代谢数据作为预测输入

decisions.text: Before human extrapolation, require at least three distinct species qualified for the specific parameter being predicted.
decisions.does_not_block: Supported upstream NCA, data preparation or animal modeling

decisions.text: Complete supported endpoints and submit qualified parameters for extrapolation review. A compartmental animal model is not mandatory. Keep unresolved project objectives and evidence gaps visible.
Reviewed human-source in vitro binding and metabolism evidence may be used as prediction inputs.
decisions.supersession_scope: Earlier blanket deferral of these human-source in vitro inputs; no extension of permission to target-drug human in vivo PK observations

publication.note: This record preserves the confirmed human decision. It is not an R-rule artifact, does not alter existing approvals, and is not automatically injected into unrelated projects. Reconcile affected prior rules during formal publication.

unresolved: Evidence and acceptance criteria for qualifying a species-parameter estimate
Whether and under what review conditions published same-drug summary parameters without raw observations may count
